title: Real services. Inspectable evidence.
body:
Oracle AI Database + Amazon Bedrock

Titan V2 embeds three synthetic policies.
Oracle ranks evidence with cosine distance.
Nova Lite generates a cited answer.

Read-only · No permanent ingestion · No cached answers
cues: This demonstration uses real Oracle and Bedrock services with three synthetic policies.
Titan creates embeddings, Oracle retrieves evidence, and Nova generates a cited answer.
The application is local; the database and model calls run in the cloud.

title: Choose a question, then run RAG
cues: Select a policy question in the browser application.
Click Run live RAG to call Bedrock and Oracle.
The choices cover transfers, warranties, recycling, and missing evidence.

title: Embeddings: the actual runtime call
cues: The Python code invokes Titan Text Embeddings version two through the AWS SDK.
It requests one thousand twenty-four dimensions and validates the returned vector.
The same embedding model processes every document and each new question.

title: Oracle performs the retrieval
cues: This is the SQL actually executed by the live demonstration.
Bound documents become vectors; Oracle orders them by exact cosine distance.
A temporary CLOB holds the large payload. No persistent tables are changed.

title: Nova receives the retrieved evidence
cues: This Converse call uses the configured Nova Lite model.
The prompt contains the question and the chunks returned by Oracle.
The system instruction requests citations and rejects unsupported answers.

title: Transfer policy: 37 hours
cues: This capture shows the result returned by the live browser application.
The transfer policy ranks first and supplies the thirty-seven-hour approval requirement.
The evidence text and distance are visible, so you can inspect the citation.

title: A different question changes the evidence
cues: The sensor warranty question retrieves a different document as the top result.
Its eighteen-month answer is supported by the displayed warranty policy.
Each click calls the services again; these are not prewritten application answers.

title: Insufficient evidence is a valid result
cues: Project Aspen has no policy in this deliberately small document fixture.
Inspect the live response instead of accepting a borrowed policy for another project.
This example is a useful check, not a comprehensive hallucination evaluation.

title: Run the complete RAG flow
body:
1. Install requirements.txt into a Python environment.
2. Configure private Oracle TCPS EZConnect+ and wallet.
3. Sign into your authorized AWS SDK profile.
4. Run: python rag_smoke_test.py
5. Run: python rag/app.py
6. Open the loopback URL; select a question; run RAG.

Synthetic policies, not business data. No persistent writes.
See rag/README.md for configuration and expected results.
cues: Install requirements and configure private Oracle and AWS access.
Run the smoke test, start the app, and open its loopback URL.
Inspect the retrieved policy, citation, and answer for each question.
